budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town approved the FY25 library budget at $583,889.77.
The director reported 91% of the year elapsed and the budget 76% expended.
Some retroactive staff payments were not included in the report, about $11k.
A surplus is expected from the staff salary line, and the director has ideas for using it. No amount printed.
A surplus is expected from heating charges. No amount printed.
Library materials were 67% expended, and some databases need renewal.
The attached director's report totals the FY24 budget line items as expended to date.
About $1800 in interest has accrued on the invested funds; CD rates are good so CDs will roll over.
The Friends plant sale fundraiser made over $1100.
The teen room estimate has been delayed; no amount printed.
The director awaits an electrical estimate for sign lighting before installation; no amount printed.
Proposals for 3D printing as a service should account for materials cost; no amount printed.
